why: Tests step, fix round 1, for slice 10 of the Reflect ban (0554, ticket 1056) in next/, libfabrika's cloudflare/ folder, after the review sent it back (field/runs/2026-11-16-reflect-ban-s10-review1.json, at cc7bd5ca5), on docs/plan/quests/reflect-ban-PLAN.md signed at 4e9601147 (kind 5, kind 10, amendment point 7, L8's row). (1) L8 in cloudflare/control.laws.test.ts is rewritten for the plan's kind 5, a door that decodes each method's own arguments: it reads the door's table of argument schemas, Payloads in control.ts, under the names the law calls (one tuple schema per method, the payload of Effect's Rpc.make), draws a valid request from that schema's Effect Arbitrary, encoded and sent as JSON, and mixes in noise (JSON values for the whole list or one argument, one argument dropped, one too many). Its oracle decodes what the door received with the same schema: a valid request reaches its object exactly once with the decoded values, an invalid one is refused with bad_row before any call, an unknown name answers unknown_method, and a Project commit naming its own process answers reserved, calling nothing. It is an it.effect.prop over a Schema walk (seed, free picks, project, name) that asks each run for every case it has not reached yet, and fails loudly when one is never reached: each method called, and for each target a refused argument list and a refused name, and the reserved commit. No per-method argument schema is exported today: none of the 31 methods has a tuple schema of its parameters, and the door's table holds only names (control.ts:33-74). The build must add and export Payloads from control.ts. (2) The six settingsStart @ts-expect-error lines are gone; each stub answers Start.Reply.cases.ok.make({ value: StartsTest.receipt(x) }), typed as the member's answer (ObjectService.test.ts, alarm.laws.test.ts twice, error-cause.test.ts, index.test.ts, p14.test.ts). The two kind 10 lines stay: platform.test.ts:167 and p14.test.ts's Connection stub. (3) L8 drops vi.mock of cloudflare:workers (0555) and decodes inside Effect.gen with Schema.decodeUnknownEffect (0576), and is written as it.effect.prop with Schema inputs (0579), so no finding row is saved for the third review finding.
